label: Custom System (pure free-form)
description: No rules at all — invent everything. Great for pure AI-generated settings.
tldr: Custom — the rulebook is whatever the table agrees on. Use free-form fields for anything (combat style, magic cost, time system). The sheet is deliberately empty: fill exactly what your setting needs. Tip: keep a 'rules' line in the campaign world_notes so the DM/AI can reference it.
